brand.name: Al-Fahmu Learning Centre
brand.tagline: Building understanding, confidence, and focus in learning

hero.badge: Structured programmes for primary and secondary students
hero.title: Helping Students Learn Better With Confidence
hero.subtitle: We help students build strong foundations through learning that is clear, structured, and tailored to their needs. Every class is designed to improve understanding, confidence, and academic performance.

structured.title: Structured learning rhythm
structured.description: Weekly lessons are mapped clearly so students always know what they are building next.

personal.title: Guidance that adapts
personal.description: Students receive patient support when they need revision, practice, or confidence rebuilding.

progress.title: Progress you can feel
progress.description: We focus on understanding, confidence, and discipline instead of rushing through content.

panel.title: A learning environment that feels calm, polished, and reassuring
points: Consistent class routines help students arrive better prepared for tests and exams.
Simple lesson delivery supports students who need stronger foundations before moving faster.
Quick WhatsApp communication keeps enquiries, schedules, and registration more responsive.
panel.quote: Every session is designed to make learning easier to understand, not just more intense.

about.title: A friendly, professional learning centre focused on real student growth
about.description: At Al-Fahmu Learning Centre, we believe every student can succeed when given the right guidance. With friendly teachers, a structured approach, and both online and physical classes, we create a learning experience that is focused, comfortable, and effective for every student.

structured.title: Well-paced syllabus breakdown
structured.description: Topics are unpacked in manageable steps so students can strengthen understanding without feeling overloaded.

confidence.title: Confidence built steadily
confidence.description: Consistent support helps students ask questions, try again, and improve weak areas without embarrassment.

guidance.title: Close, student-friendly guidance
guidance.description: Patient explanations create a classroom atmosphere that feels approachable, focused, and encouraging.

progress.title: Progress that is easier to notice
progress.description: With clear routines and goals, parents can see improvement in both discipline and understanding.

subjects.title: Learning options shaped around what students actually need support with
subjects.description: We offer a range of subjects and learning support programmes, including core academics, reading foundation, KAFA, Iqra', and Al-Quran. Each programme is structured to help students master the basics, strengthen weak areas, and learn with greater confidence.

bahasaMelayu.title: Bahasa Melayu
bahasaMelayu.description: Builds reading, writing, and language use with clearer explanations and stronger exam readiness.

english.title: English
english.description: Supports reading, writing, and spoken confidence through structured daily-use language practice.

mathematics.title: Mathematics
mathematics.description: Step-by-step practice strengthens numeracy, problem solving, and answer techniques.

science.title: Science
science.description: Clarifies key concepts with simpler explanations so abstract topics feel more approachable.

belajarMembaca.title: Reading Foundation
belajarMembaca.description: Patient early-reading guidance helps students build literacy basics more comfortably and confidently.

kafa.title: KAFA
kafa.description: Structured KAFA support helps students follow lessons more clearly and retain key topics more effectively.

iqra.title: Iqra'
iqra.description: Student-friendly Iqra' guidance builds reading familiarity gradually and more consistently.

alQuran.title: Al-Quran
alQuran.description: Guided Quran reading support focuses on fluency, pronunciation, and student confidence.

testimonials.title: Feedback that reflects real change in learning confidence
testimonials.description: We want every student to leave class not only having attended, but understanding more clearly, feeling more confident, and staying better prepared for school.
